requirements.invariant: Every material change identifies exactly one ChangeType and one RiskClass before execution eligibility.
Each change names the semantic authority owning the state or behavior being changed.
Material changes carry complete user/system, dependency, security/privacy, data/state compatibility and recovery impact assessment.
Applicable security/privacy impact cannot remain UNKNOWN before consequential eligibility.
requirements.failure: Unknown material impact -> deny/fail closed downstream

requirements.invariant: Approval policy is risk-tiered and bound to the exact current risk/context policy snapshot.
requirements.failure: Policy unavailable -> no classified high-risk progression

acceptance: all five requirements must have executable passing evidence
